## 4. Judgement findings

Nothing found. The three new cases and subsequent actual package checks support no product finding to route. The observer interruption and correction are orchestration history, preserved above, not a product defect.

## 5. Reached behavior that the added cases did not break

- Closed named-field manifest admission: valid model/scenario selection reaches the compiled CLI; positional sequence admission refuses before model/scenario outputs.
- The published mixed directory: explicit and default model selection agree, generated YAML stays unlisted, and omitted scenarios remain absent for both suite versions.
- Exact string filenames: YAML string values preserve scalar-looking spellings, while wrong scalar kinds in the inactive role refuse before active-file reading.

The inherited A1–A24 and current observed-bindings, qualified-release, normalization and runtime acquisition cases also execute in the final package. They are inherited coverage, not newly added cases. Runtime acquisition reaches its intentional missing-realization refusal after valid model/runtime/build admission; it is not successful runtime execution. Qualified release uses a finite offline ORAS fixture. Existing semantic refusal output may contain incomplete diagnostic evidence; the acquisition contract does not erase that distinction. The named model/projection has explicit expression limits for filesystem facts, dynamic role activation, complete path grammar/uniqueness and byte custody; declaration validity alone is not acquisition behavior.

The original implementor baseline executed CLI SHA256 `d8b1fd6db5438f3ac294f44f1e760358d247219e68b3259564c3c517e4ae2c25` was overwritten before a native copy was retained. Its exact image remains unavailable; the original source snapshots, outputs and actual hash receipt remain. The independently supplied old CLI SHA256 `94983b7227d8b5c3c69cdb448cf4dfe7a4d8c65b086ae7ce54d1db75c607ebf8` is a different actual compatibility control, not that missing baseline. No replacement baseline was rebuilt. The maintained old document-reader checks are unconditional; the reviewer launch explicitly sets ESS_DISCOVERY_OLD_CLI and the indexed nine old-CLI invocations actually ran. Original implementation metadata also identifies its reconstructed earliest runner and possible early observation delay; this report does not upgrade those limitations into contemporaneous retention.
